title: Social expectations and norm nudging in anti-coordination problems: An El Farol Bar Game experiment
title_zh: 反协调问题中的社会期望与规范助推：一个El Farol酒吧博弈实验
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-09-01 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Norm nudging interventions seek to influence behavior by shaping what individuals expect others to do ( empirical expectations ) or regard as appropriate ( normative expectations ). We study how such interventions operate in an anonymous anti-coordination problem, using an online El Farol Bar Game experiment composed of two studies. Study 1 elicits social expectations (empirical and normative) and personal normative beliefs before subjects make their decision in the El Farol Bar Game. Study 2 implements norm nudges by providing participants with pre-decision messages based on the social expectations elicited in Study 1. Results show that subjects conform not only to their empirical expectations, but also to their personal normative beliefs. Normative expectations exert weaker and less consistent effects. Moreover, norm nudging interventions primarily induce prudence by reducing behavior that jeopardizes social welfare.
abstract_zh: 规范助推干预旨在通过塑造个体对他人行为（经验预期）或社会认可行为（规范预期）的认知来影响其行为。我们通过一项由两项研究组成的在线“艾尔法罗尔酒吧博弈”实验，探讨此类干预在匿名反协调问题中的作用。研究一在受试者于艾尔法罗尔酒吧博弈中做出决策前，引出其社会预期（经验性与规范性）及个人规范信念。研究二则基于研究一中引出的社会预期，向参与者提供决策前信息，实施规范助推。结果表明，受试者不仅遵循其经验预期，还遵循其个人规范信念。规范性预期的影响较弱且不一致。此外，规范助推干预主要通过减少损害社会福利的行为来诱导谨慎行事。

title: A Nascent International Financial Channel of China's Monetary Policy Transmission
title_zh: 中国货币政策传导的新兴国际金融渠道
authors: Zhou, Sili, Ma, Chang, Rebucci, Alessandro
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Chinese private portfolio equity outflows, though small compared to other Chinese outflows, are growing rapidly because of capital account liberalization and capital flight. Using granular stock-holding data on Qualified Domestic Institutional Investor (QDII) mutual funds, we identify a nascent financial channel of international transmission of Chinese monetary policy to world stocks. Event study analysis around monetary policy announcement days reveals that monetary policy tightening depresses returns of country equity indexes and individual U.S. stocks with QDII fund exposure relative to non-exposed stocks. The results are robust to controlling for the real transmission channel of Chinese monetary policy and other confounders. The effect is driven by smaller and less liquid firms, but not by China-concept stocks or those highly exposed to China
abstract_zh: 中国私人投资组合的股权流出规模虽不及其他类型的中国资本流出，但受资本账户自由化和资本外逃推动，正呈现快速增长态势。基于合格境内机构投资者（QDII）共同基金的股票持仓微观数据，我们识别出中国货币政策向全球股市传导的新兴金融渠道。围绕货币政策公告日的事件研究分析表明，相较于未受QDII基金持仓的股票，货币政策紧缩会压低受QDII基金持仓的国家股指及美国个股的收益率。在控制中国货币政策实际传导渠道及其他混杂因素后，该结论依然稳健。这一效应主要由规模较小、流动性较差的股票驱动，而非中国概念股或与中国高度关联的股票。

title: Who Profits from Amateurism? Rent-Sharing in Modern College Sports
title_zh: 谁从业余主义中获利？现代大学体育中的租金分享
authors: Garthwaite, Craig, Holz, Nicole, Keener, Jordan, Notowidigdo, Matthew
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Intercollegiate amateur athletics in the US have historically prevented student-athletes from receiving market wages, creating substantial economic rents that are primarily generated by men’s football and basketball programs. Using financial data from college athletic departments, we estimate rent-sharing elasticities to measure how rents flow to women’s sports and other men’s sports and lead to increased spending on athletic facilities and coaches’ salaries. Using player-level data, we find that the rent-sharing transfers spending away from students who are more likely to be Black and come from poor neighborhoods towards students more likely to be White and come from higher-income neighborhoods.
abstract_zh: 美国高校业余体育历来禁止学生运动员获得市场工资，由此产生了主要由男子橄榄球和篮球项目创造的大量经济租金。利用高校体育部门的财务数据，我们估算了租金分享弹性，以衡量租金如何流向女子体育及其他男子体育项目，并导致体育设施和教练薪资支出增加。基于运动员个体数据，我们发现租金分享将支出从更可能是黑人和来自贫困社区的学生，转移至更可能是白人和来自高收入社区的学生。

title: Long-Run Intergenerational Effects of Social Security
title_zh: 社会保障的长期代际效应
authors: Daniel K. Fetter, Lee M. Lockwood, Paul Mohnen
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Both historically and today, support of aging parents has largely taken the form of in-kind transfers that require physical proximity, such as housing and caregiving. If Social Security substitutes for such support, it can relax constraints on where recipients' children live and work. We investigate the long-run intergenerational effects of the early Social Security program, exploiting within-occupation, cross-industry differences in coverage and a new dataset linking parents to their children's later-life outcomes. We find that sons whose parents had greater predicted coverage moved farther from their childhood homes, earned more, and lived in better neighborhoods late in life. We find no such effects for daughters, who tended to provide forms of support less easily replaced by Social Security. The gains considerably exceeded the associated Social Security benefits for the average family, with migration to better-matched labor markets a likely key driver. We propose that the early program enabled families to realize gains from migration that were back-loaded, uncertain, and difficult to contract on.
abstract_zh: 无论历史上还是当今，赡养年迈父母主要采取需要物理邻近性的实物转移形式，例如提供住房和照料。若社会保障制度替代了此类支持，则可缓解对受赡养者子女居住地和工作地点的约束。我们利用早期社会保障计划在职业内部、行业之间的覆盖差异，并结合将父母与其子女晚年生活状况相关联的新数据集，研究了该计划的长期代际效应。研究发现，父母预期保障覆盖率较高的家庭中，儿子成年后远离童年居住地、收入更高且晚年居住社区条件更优。但此类效应对女儿并不显著——女儿往往提供更难以被社会保障替代的支持形式。对普通家庭而言，这些收益远超其获得的社会保障福利，而迁移至更匹配的劳动力市场很可能是关键驱动因素。我们认为，早期计划使家庭能够实现迁移带来的滞后性、不确定且难以契约化的收益。

title: Subsidies for reshoring: evidence from Taiwan
title_zh: 回流补贴：来自台湾的证据
abstract: This paper empirically investigates the causal effect of subsidies on reshoring in Taiwan. The Taiwanese government has provided subsidies to Taiwanese firms to encourage them to relocate their factories from China back to Taiwan. Using the matched data between firm-level business information and the list of subsidy recipients from 2016 to 2023, we investigate how subsidy recipients change their behavior in both China and Taiwan. To mitigate the bias introduced by the selection mechanism in this subsidy, we employ the doubly robust difference-in-differences method. As a result, we found that this subsidy program has not induced reshoring or relocation of export base from China to Taiwan. Although some recipients expanded their production facilities and increased domestic sales, these changes were not significant enough to increase production and employment in Taiwan. These findings suggest that financial incentives alone are insufficient to offset the structural advantages of established production networks in China.
abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了补贴对台湾地区企业回迁的因果效应。台湾当局向本地企业提供补贴，鼓励其将工厂从中国大陆迁回台湾。通过匹配2016至2023年间企业层面商业信息与补贴接收方名单的数据，我们考察了补贴接收方在中国大陆和台湾地区的行为变化。为缓解该补贴选择机制带来的偏误，我们采用双重稳健双重差分法。结果表明，该补贴计划并未促使企业从中国大陆向台湾回迁或转移出口基地。尽管部分受补贴企业扩大了生产设施并增加了内销，但这些变化尚不足以显著提升台湾地区的生产与就业。这些发现表明，仅凭财政激励不足以抵消中国大陆成熟生产网络的结构性优势。

title: What Causes Geographic Variation in Drug Prescribing? Evidence from Physician Migration
title_zh: 医生迁移视角下药品处方地理差异的成因分析
abstract: In this article, we examine the importance of individual physicians in explaining the significant variation in prescription drug spending in Medicare Part D. By tracking prescribing behavior before and after physician relocations, we find that movers' prescribing converges toward the average of their new location. However, this convergence is far from complete, highlighting the importance of idiosyncratic physician‐specific factors. Overall, these physician‐specific factors explain about 60 to 70 percent of the cross‐sectional variation in prescription drug spending, suggesting that physicians are one of the most important supply‐side determinants of this variation. We investigate several potential mechanisms behind this partial convergence.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在医疗保险D部分处方药支出显著差异中，个体医生的重要性。通过追踪医生迁移前后的处方行为，我们发现迁移者的处方模式会逐渐趋近于新地区的平均水平。然而，这种趋同远未完全实现，凸显了医生个体特有因素的关键作用。总体而言，这些医生特有因素解释了处方药支出横截面差异的60%至70%，表明医生是导致这种差异的最重要供给侧决定因素之一。我们进一步研究了这种部分趋同背后的若干潜在机制。
